description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Built is hiring an Innovation Software Engineer I for its Marketplace business unit, which develops services supporting construction projects, including inspections, appraisals, insurance, and materials sourcing. The role builds and improves software, prototypes, and AI-powered workflows while learning production engineering and translating customer needs into product improvements.
Software Engineer 1 building Marketplace product features, APIs, prototypes, and AI-powered workflow automation with customer-informed iteration

Responsibilities:
• Develop features, APIs, internal tools, and reusable components that support Marketplace products, working alongside experienced engineers on design, implementation, testing, and code review
• Help turn early product concepts into working prototypes and MVPs. Build quickly, learn from feedback, and improve what you've shipped
• Use AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow and help build AI-powered features, including document extraction, data validation, agent-driven workflows, and automation
• Develop your understanding of backend services, APIs, asynchronous workflows, data models, testing, and the practices that make software reliable and maintainable
• Participate in customer discovery conversations, observe how people use the products, and help translate what you learn into improvements
• Identify friction in workflows, fix bugs, improve usability, and help make products more reliable and valuable for customers
• Learn how a workflow operates before automating it, then build tools and integrations that reduce repetitive work and improve efficiency
• Participate in code reviews, ask questions, learn from feedback, and gradually take responsibility for larger pieces of engineering work

Requirements:
• 0–2 years of experience in software engineering, product engineering, or a related technical role
• Recent graduates and career changers with strong hands-on projects are encouraged to apply
• Experience writing code in TypeScript, JavaScript, or Python, whether through professional work, internships, coursework, or personal projects
• Familiarity with APIs, databases, and fundamental software engineering concepts
• Experience using AI coding tools or experimenting with LLMs to build something, along with curiosity about how AI can be incorporated into real products
• At least one project you've built that you can talk through, including the problem you were solving, how you approached it, and what you learned
• A genuine interest in building software, solving problems, and understanding how your work impacts customers
• Comfort learning unfamiliar technologies, asking for help, and incorporating feedback
• Strong communication skills and an interest in collaborating closely with engineers, Product, and other teams

Preferred:
• Experience with React, Node.js, SQL, AWS, or other cloud technologies
• Exposure to LLM APIs, agent frameworks, RAG, document processing, or workflow automation
• Experience building side projects, contributing to open source, participating in hackathons, or launching something people actually use
• Internship or early-career experience in a startup, SaaS company, fintech, or another fast-moving technical environment
• Interest in financial services, construction, real estate, payments, lending, or other complex B2B industries
